messages:
anika: Quick heads-up — we're kicking off a new GPU project in kr-north1 (Seoul). Need cloud account + VPC scaffold, GPU quota requests, and handoff to networking. Who can pick up the runbook tasks?

matt: I can take the VPC + subnet/CIDR design. Quick Q: do we want per-project NATs or a centralized egress pattern for the region? cost/latency tradeoffs.

sourav: For GPU workloads I usually recommend centralized Cloud NAT + shared egress to keep costs visible and avoid duplicated NAT IPs. That said if we're expecting bursty storage egress per-tenant, per-project NAT might simplify IAM. Estimate: centralized NAT adds ~0.02 USD/GB depending on routes.

ops-bot: project-scaffolder created project redwood-kr1-gpu (ID: redwood-kr1-gpu). Services enabled: compute.googleapis.com, container.googleapis.com, logging.googleapis.com.

anika: thanks @matt and @sourav. Matt — can you draft the CIDR plan? We prefer non-overlapping /20s per project and reserve /16 for region. Example suggestion: 10.128.0.0/16 region block -> subnets 10.128.0.0/18, 10.128.64.0/18, 10.128.128.0/18 across AZs.

matt: SGTM. I'll post a tiny terraform snippet for the scaffold, put in infra repo under: infra/modules/region-scaffold/kr-north1.

matt: ```hcl
resource "google_compute_network" "kr1_vpc" {
  name = "vpc-kr1"
  auto_create_subnetworks = false
}

module "subnets" {
  source = "../modules/subnet"
  vpc     = google_compute_network.kr1_vpc.name
  cidrs   = ["10.128.0.0/18", "10.128.64.0/18", "10.128.128.0/18"]
  azs     = ["kr-north1-a","kr-north1-b","kr-north1-c"]
}
```

sourav: Also: GPU quota request — open ticket with cloud ops and attach expected instance types (a100, h100) + target QPS and start date. Use the internal form: https://go/requota and select "accelerator (GPU) quota". Put expected vCPUs and GPUs in the description. Typical ask: start conservatively (e.g., 8 x A100) and request burst to 32 for smoke run.

jeff: networking ops: please ensure KMS key for disk encryption is in place and project has VPC Service Controls off by default for infra projects. Also enable flow logs on all subnets.

anika: Ops checklist summary (for handoff):
- project created (ops-bot confirmed)
- region CIDR allocated (matt)
- subnets + routing + cloud NAT decision (matt + sourav)
- GPU quota request filed (sourav)
- KMS + IAM for disk encryption (jeff)
- Logging / flow logs + monitoring dashboards (lisa to confirm)
- Cost guardrails: budget alert + spend threshold for egress (finance tag)

lisa: I'll set up the per-project dashboards and add token-level cost alerting to the project's billing export. Also will create a Grafana dashboard for GPU utilization and per-node pod evictions.

matt: One more note — if we want fast fallback to cheaper model variants, ensure service endpoints allow routing to eu or us regions and add a fallback policy in the routing layer. Not infra-blocking but good to flag.

anika: timeline: aim to have scaffold + quotas requested by EOD Friday, initial smoke cluster next week. Assigning handoff: @matt owns VPC/networking, @sourav owns quota & quota followups, @lisa owns observability. @jeff please do encryption/IAM.

ops-bot: ticket INFRA-4827 created: "kr-north1 GPU project scaffold". Assignees: matt, sourav, lisa, jeff. ETA: 2026-03-27.

jeff: ack. I'll prepare the KMS policy and a short terraform for CMEK binding.

matt: I'll open a PR to infra repo with the subnet module and CIDR map, pinging networking-oncall for review. :thumbsup:

anika: perfect — thanks everyone. I'll update the region onboarding doc and move this thread into the runbook appendix once infra PRs merge. :party:
